blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mixed adjustments in fuel prices may greet the motorists in the first week of November, with gasoline slated for a price hike. Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said gasoline prices may jump by P2.90 to P3.20 per liter.
